correctness.rationale: The proof derives |V_i|=(q-1)q^(ell-i-1) and adjacency i+j>=ell directly from the chain-ring valuation. Twin classes imply at most one white vertex per layer. Choosing the maximum white valuation t and source layer ell-t gives exactly one white neighbor; a blue source exists except when q=2 and ell=2. This yields the full product polynomial. The quotient matrix Q_ij=1 iff i+j>=ell is nonsingular after column reversal, giving rank ell-1; M<=Z proves exact minimum rank and maximum nullity.

value.rationale: The theorem gives the complete zero forcing enumerator and every minimum forcing set for all finite chain-ring zero-divisor graphs, not only a numerical minimum. It proves exact maximum nullity/minimum rank and shows that the polynomial roots recover the residue-field order and nilpotency length. This provides a natural forcing-theoretic encoding of the chain-ring valuation filtration.
